steps.npc: My pub's called The Golden Field. It's where all the local workers come to relax and unwind after a hard day. I try to keep it really nice here for them. Anyway, are you drinking?

options.text: Have you heard any rumours here?

steps.player: Have you heard any rumours here?

steps.text: If Client of Kourend has not been started:

steps.npc: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.

steps.text: If The Queen of Thieves has not been started:

steps.npc: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.

steps.text: If The Depths of Despair has not been started:

steps.npc: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.

steps.text: If Tale of the Righteous has not been started:

steps.npc: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.

steps.text: If The Forsaken Tower has not been started:

steps.npc: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.

steps.text: If The Ascent of Arceuus has not been started:

steps.npc: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.

steps.text: If A Kingdom Divided has not been started:

steps.npc: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.

steps.text: If all quests above have been completed:

steps.npc: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
I like a customer who knows when to stop.
